findings.finding: Native-materialization stale-preview regression initially changed both global and game INIs.
findings.resolution: Test now rejects stale preview with only native per-game materialization; later global change and owned-option Undo conflict are checked separately.

findings.finding: Initial collector settings labels were not derived from actual frozen native INIs.
findings.resolution: Collector derives exact global/local effective settings and configuration inventory; only1x/2x with manual/automatic frameskip disabled can compare.

findings.finding: Raw report declarations could diverge from actual window/status/counters or retained starting/provenance inputs.
findings.resolution: Collected-run validation rechecks retained config/state/scene/statistics source/build review, exact game/unpaused statuses, finite monotonic windows, metric means/window/analysis/summary and raw digests.

findings.finding: Publisher could retarget a reused PID and alias command/request paths.
findings.resolution: Retained launch start ticks are required and checked twice; resolved/hardlink output aliases reject; actual SDL tests cover axes/buttons, expiry, foreign/late input and identity failures.

findings.finding: Replay timing needed binding to frozen axis values and observed hold completion.
findings.resolution: Requested/published/applied values, issue/deadline times and native neutral/next-command end are validated within frozen tolerance.

findings.finding: Original-source export omitted the new original MIT controller C source.
findings.resolution: An exact source-only path allowlist includes dev/host_virtual_controller.c while unrelated C/native/binaries stay excluded.

findings.finding: Original0003 interrupted publication preserves prior usable completion in only2/10 deterministic windows.
findings.resolution: Diagnostic evidence retains exact observed failure and raw identities. Optional0006 immutable generation snapshots plus final-result-first publication is being implemented; no preservation pass granted yet.

accepted_boundaries: Existing settings authority, native process supervision, transaction ownership and qualification gates are retained.
Collector build receipts and review documents are provenance declarations, not cryptographic source-to-binary proof.
No frontend runtime API, device activation path, selected native binary or selected upstream patch is added.
Original0003 interruption diagnostics use real extracted native functions with explicit serializer/platform fixtures; they are not whole-emulator or power-loss tests.
Ordinary savedata/Continue and broader gameplay measurement evidence remain pending until independently reviewed fresh native evidence exists.
Historical dev19 package/CI receipts do not certify this changed tree; published dev16 remains unchanged.
